title: Visit Huckstash 1

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Ok kid. Sure thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok kid. Sure thing.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Get lost Oogle.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Get lost Oogle.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Oogle?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oogle?

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Nothing worse than an Oogle who don't know they're an Oogle. Leave me alone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing worse than an Oogle who don't know they're an Oogle. Leave me alone.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I got your details from McFellow.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I got your details from McFellow.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I got your details from McFellow.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I got your details from McFellow.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: McFellow? The Frother? Never met a person more romantic for the tracks, and I'm a lifelong hobo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: McFellow? The Frother? Never met a person more romantic for the tracks, and I'm a lifelong hobo.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A Frother?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A Frother?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm following a line of investigation regarding The Aseptic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm following a line of investigation regarding The Aseptic.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm following a line of investigation regarding The Aseptic.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm following a line of investigation regarding The Aseptic.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Yeah, a basher. Someone who gets a hard-on for the train network. Useful person to know as a hobo actually. Nerds like McFellow are pretty wired in.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, a basher. Someone who gets a hard-on for the train network. Useful person to know as a hobo actually. Nerds like McFellow are pretty wired in.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: I wondered when one of you would be knocking on this door.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wondered when one of you would be knocking on this door.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Not more of this. I already told that Corpster hack what I know. Which is diddle-drip. I ain't seen anything, my guys haven't seen anything and if I was Aseptic? I'd certainly be too busy slicing throats to be down here all day. Get lost.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not more of this. I already told that Corpster hack what I know. Which is diddle-drip. I ain't seen anything, my guys haven't seen anything and if I was Aseptic? I'd certainly be too busy slicing throats to be down here all day. Get lost.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like you know something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like you know something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Corpster? You mean Gamova?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Corpster? You mean Gamova?

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Yeah that's her name. Mean, rude, patronizing. Like every other Corpster out there. Which is why I'm done talking to you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah that's her name. Mean, rude, patronizing. Like every other Corpster out there. Which is why I'm done talking to you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't work for her, I'm being coerced.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't work for her, I'm being coerced.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't work for her, I'm being coerced.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't work for her, I'm being coerced.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Hmmmm. Wouldn't trust you as far as I could throw a billy-coupling but that does sound like the kind of thing she'd do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmmmm. Wouldn't trust you as far as I could throw a billy-coupling but that does sound like the kind of thing she'd do.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Kid, I live on the railways. I know lots of things. We all do down here. None of it is any interest to you lot, so we just keep to ourselves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Kid, I live on the railways. I know lots of things. We all do down here. None of it is any interest to you lot, so we just keep to ourselves.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Pavement-Pacers?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pavement-Pacers?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm interested.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm interested.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: This is why I don't talk to Oogles. Pavement-Pacers, Concrete-Cowboys, Briefcase-Bandits all walking the streets doing whatever the corps tell you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is why I don't talk to Oogles. Pavement-Pacers, Concrete-Cowboys, Briefcase-Bandits all walking the streets doing whatever the corps tell you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're stood on a pavement.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're stood on a pavement.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Oh, of course you are, now that Pavement-Pacers are being killed in droves. Who gave a fuck when we were the target?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, of course you are, now that Pavement-Pacers are being killed in droves. Who gave a fuck when we were the target?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So Aseptic targeted hobos?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So Aseptic targeted hobos?

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Firstly, only a hobo can say hobo. Secondly, yes. Of course he did. If you wanted to target debt orphans where else would you look first? I'd figure there are more debt orphans riding the rails than rats.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Firstly, only a hobo can say hobo. Secondly, yes. Of course he did. If you wanted to target debt orphans where else would you look first? I'd figure there are more debt orphans riding the rails than rats.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Funny and ugly. I've hit the jackpot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Funny and ugly. I've hit the jackpot.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How long ago was this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How long ago was this?

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: I'd say, at least Thirty NATA-logs ago. Two standard years maybe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd say, at least Thirty NATA-logs ago. Two standard years maybe.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And it was never investigated?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And it was never investigated?

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Hahaha, oh kid, who's going to investigate a bunch of hobos being offed? Sure, we reported it but if there is one thing you can rely on the Corpsters for, it's turning off their optics to anyone who doesn't own stock-options.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hahaha, oh kid, who's going to investigate a bunch of hobos being offed? Sure, we reported it but if there is one thing you can rely on the Corpsters for, it's turning off their optics to anyone who doesn't own stock-options.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I mean, I can see why they didn't investigate.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean, I can see why they didn't investigate.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I mean, I can see why they didn't investigate.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I mean, I can see why they didn't investigate.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's awful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's awful.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Classic pavement-patter.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Classic pavement-patter.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Most things are.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Most things are.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Anything else you can tell me? Got a description?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anything else you can tell me? Got a description?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Anything else you can tell me? Got a description?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Anything else you can tell me? Got a description?

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: You speak pretty fluent cop don't you? Look, I never saw him, never had no reason to. That said, I do know someone who saw him first hand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You speak pretty fluent cop don't you? Look, I never saw him, never had no reason to. That said, I do know someone who saw him first hand.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where can I find them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where can I find them?

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Well shit, ain't you the little runaway freight train that could! You should hit the brakes before you get derailed. This is a path even a hobo shouldn't walk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well shit, ain't you the little runaway freight train that could! You should hit the brakes before you get derailed. This is a path even a hobo shouldn't walk.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I appreciate the warning but this is important.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I appreciate the warning but this is important.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I appreciate the warning but this is important.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I appreciate the warning but this is important.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Don't patronise me. Just tell me where to find them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't patronise me. Just tell me where to find them.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Don't patronise me. Just tell me where to find them.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Don't patronise me. Just tell me where to find them.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: I met a blind monk once who said "There is nothing that isn't important" That includes the safety of my crew. I can't be giving out details left and right to every street-Oogle I meet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I met a blind monk once who said "There is nothing that isn't important" That includes the safety of my crew. I can't be giving out details left and right to every street-Oogle I meet.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: You know what slack-tension is? You know what riding suicide means? You know how to catch out on a meridian sidewinder carrying sixteen terra-tonnes of sand-blasted foundation slate? No, I didn't think so. You want to walk the tracks, you gotta prove you know your highline from your clove-hitch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know what slack-tension is? You know what riding suicide means? You know how to catch out on a meridian sidewinder carrying sixteen terra-tonnes of sand-blasted foundation slate? No, I didn't think so. You want to walk the tracks, you gotta prove you know your highline from your clove-hitch.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What about in exchange for this month's NATA-log?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about in exchange for this month's NATA-log?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What about in exchange for this month's NATA-log?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What about in exchange for this month's NATA-log?

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: You're bluffing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're bluffing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Got it right here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Got it right here.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Where did you get it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where did you get it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: McFellow gave it to me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: McFellow gave it to me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not relevant.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not relevant.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Probably best that I don't know. So if I give you my contact, you'll give me the NATA-Log?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Probably best that I don't know. So if I give you my contact, you'll give me the NATA-Log?

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Told you that kid was the real deal. So if I give you my contact, you'll give me the NATA-Log?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Told you that kid was the real deal. So if I give you my contact, you'll give me the NATA-Log?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like a fair deal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like a fair deal.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: I'll give you her details but I cannot stress enough, you are an Oogle, If you've never hopped a train before, this will be dangerous. There is a high chance you will not walk away from this. I don't have time to train you and neither will my crew.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll give you her details but I cannot stress enough, you are an Oogle, If you've never hopped a train before, this will be dangerous. There is a high chance you will not walk away from this. I don't have time to train you and neither will my crew.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can I just take public transport?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can I just take public transport?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can I just take public transport?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can I just take public transport?

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: I mean... I guess you could... One more thing. If you're heading in that direction, could you give DeeDee a message from me. I have it right here. We have some... History.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean... I guess you could... One more thing. If you're heading in that direction, could you give DeeDee a message from me. I have it right here. We have some... History.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Ok, you're looking for a woman that goes by the name DeeDee Thumb-it. Formidable force of nature. She saw Aseptic kill a man. With her own optics.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok, you're looking for a woman that goes by the name DeeDee Thumb-it. Formidable force of nature. She saw Aseptic kill a man. With her own optics.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where can I find her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where can I find her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why can't you deliver it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why can't you deliver it?

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: Look, I really meant what I said about her being formidable. Plus, the last time we saw each other... Look never mind. Please give it to her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I really meant what I said about her being formidable. Plus, the last time we saw each other... Look never mind. Please give it to her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have enough to do without running your errands.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have enough to do without running your errands.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have enough to do without running your errands.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have enough to do without running your errands.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure anything I can do to help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure anything I can do to help.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sure anything I can do to help.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sure anything I can do to help.

nodes.speaker: Huckstash
nodes.text: You really are not full of surprises.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You really are not full of surprises.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll never obey the corps.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll never obey the corps.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm interested in the Aseptic case.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm interested in the Aseptic case.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm interested in the Aseptic case.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm interested in the Aseptic case.
